title: Readers accept plain format names with formatVersion for registry, host, registration, projection, capture and local state
summary: Registry files (registry, registry-package, registries and the kit and workspace collection indexes), host release and cache, host state and pending, guard, hook and lifecycle registration state and pending, host projection state, projection publication, release minting, installed implementations, host joins, runner evidence, the capture snapshot (snapshot), the graph cache, the migration journal, the tracked-workspaces list, the kit-collections record, evidence receipts and the context-hook identity are now read under a plain format name with an integer `formatVersion`, as well as under the exact original literals, which keep their digests; unknown formats and versions are refused. These documents are still written under the original literals in this release, and `ia capture --json` still reports `ia-snapshot-1`; a later release switches the writers. Saved plans and the graph cache are read only by the build that wrote them and already use the plain names: a plan saved by an earlier version is recognised and must be made again. The exported format constants `CAPTURE_FORMAT`, `RUNNER_EVIDENCE_FORMAT`, `INSTALLED_IMPLEMENTATIONS_FORMAT`, `EVIDENCE_RECEIPT_FORMAT` and `RESOLUTION_FORMAT` now hold the plain names.
